item.title: Version 1.9.0
item.description:
Retext 1.9.0

What's New in v1.9.0

Retext 1.9.0 requires macOS 26 (Tahoe). If your Mac runs macOS 15, Retext 1.8.1 keeps working and will not offer this update. Every new feature below is off until you turn it on in Settings.

New Features

  • Dictation - Hold the right Option key, speak, and let go. Your words are typed where the cursor is, transcribed on your Mac. If the text cannot be typed (you switched apps or clicked a password field), it waits in a small window with a Copy button instead
  • Hands-free dictation (beta) - Double-tap the right Option key and keep talking. Each sentence is typed when you pause. It pauses itself in password fields and password managers, while a note is recording, and during calls. If another app also opens on a double-tap of Option, such as the Claude desktop app, change that app's shortcut
  • Polish dictation (beta) - Removes filler words and fixes punctuation with Apple Intelligence on your Mac, with modes for messages, email and notes, and a different mode per app
  • Voice commands (beta) - Say "new paragraph", "delete that" or "insert snippet" followed by a snippet name while dictating
  • Snippet suggestions (beta) - As you type, Retext shows a matching snippet in faint text. Tab accepts it, Esc dismisses it. Snippets with dates and fill-in fields work too
  • AI suggestions (beta) - Short sentence completions from Apple Intelligence on your Mac, using only the paragraph you are typing
  • Notes - Record a meeting or a thought and get a transcript and summary on your Mac. Save any part of it as a snippet
  • Menu bar panel (beta) - Search and insert snippets, see recent dictations and notes, and pick a microphone, all from the menu bar
  • Clipboard history (beta) - Keep recent copies in the menu bar panel to paste, pin or save as a snippet. Copies from password managers and anything marked private are never kept

    • Improvements

  • Home - Once you use dictation or suggestions, Home shows the words you dictated, your speaking speed and how much of your writing came from Retext
  • Microphone choice - Pick which microphone dictation uses
    • ---

    What's New in v1.8.1

    Accounts

  • License on your account - Activating a license now links it to your Retext account, ready for Pro on your other devices. A license can only be linked to one account at a time; activating or signing in under a second account asks whether to move it. Pro on this Mac still follows the key stored here
  • Delete your account - You can delete your Retext account from Settings. Team owners need to hand the team to someone else first. There is a guide at retext.io/delete-account
  • Sign-in - Signing in with Google uses a safer hand-off between your browser and the app. Existing sign-ins keep working

    • Improvements

  • Espanso import - Date variables are now imported as Retext date and time fields instead of plain text, with a note on any row whose format was changed
  • Shortcuts - Team snippets are only available to Shortcuts, Spotlight and Siri while "Include team snippets" is turned on in Settings
    • ---

    What's New in v1.8.0

    New Features

  • Menu bar - Retext now lives in your menu bar. Pause expansion in the app you are using or everywhere, see how many words your snippets saved today, and open Settings from there
  • Home - A new Home view shows your expansion stats, the apps you use snippets in most, and recent activity. All of it stays on your Mac
  • Per-app snippets - Limit a snippet to certain apps, or keep it out of others, so the same trigger can do different things in Mail and Slack
  • Import - Bring your snippets in from TextExpander, Espanso, Raycast, Alfred, or macOS text replacements, with a preview before anything is added
  • Shortcuts and Raycast - Insert snippets from the Shortcuts app or a new Raycast extension, with an optional local export you turn on in Settings

    • Improvements

  • Clipboard - Whatever you had copied comes back after an expansion, including images and formatted text, even when expansions happen back to back
  • Unsaved work - Opening Home asks before discarding a snippet you have not saved yet
    • ---

    What's New in v1.7.2

    Security

  • Password fields - Snippets no longer expand while a password field is focused or Secure Input is on, in any app
  • Bundled token removed - Earlier releases shipped a Polar access token inside the app. It has been revoked and is no longer included. If you are still on v1.0.4 or v1.0.5, please update: license checks in those two versions will stop working
  • Sign-in hardening - Sign-in redirects are now restricted to Retext's own callback, and Google accounts must have a verified email address

    • Fixes

  • Nested snippets - A snippet referenced more than once now expands every time, the five-level nesting limit is enforced, and zero-width spaces in snippet content are preserved
  • Free AI trial - Each device now gets its own trial instead of all trial users sharing one daily limit
  • Template triggers - A template installed from retext.io that clashes with an existing trigger is now renamed with a number prefix, such as `2-sig`, so it can actually fire
  • Team sync - A sync client can no longer overwrite a snippet that belongs to another team
    • ---

    What's New in v1.7.1

    New Features

  • Add to Retext — Install any prompt template from retext.io with one click. Templates arrive as ready-to-use snippets with a suggested trigger
  • Pre-loaded First Launch — Download Retext from a template page on retext.io and that template imports automatically the first time you open the app
    • ---

    What's New in v1.7.0

    New Features

  • Free Accounts — Sign in with Google to create a free account and unlock 10 snippets (up from 5)
  • Referral Program — Share your referral code from Settings and earn a free Pro month when a friend upgrades. Got a code from a friend? Enter it in Settings > Referrals
    • ---

    What's New in v1.6.0

    New

  • Interactive Tutorial — New users get a hands-on walkthrough that teaches snippet expansion by doing it, not just reading about it
  • Guided Snippet Creation — After the tutorial, pick from ready-made templates (email signature, phone number, quick reply, URL) to create your first snippet instantly
  • Dynamic Fields — Snippets now support live fields: `{date}`, `{time}`, `{clipboard}`, `{day}`, date math (`{date+7}`), and fill-in prompts (`{fill:Name}`)
  • Cursor Positioning — Add `{cursor}` to place your cursor exactly where you want it after expansion

    • Improvements

  • Fill-in Dialog — Dynamic fill-in fields show a clean dialog box to enter values before expanding
  • Live Trigger Hints — Tutorial practice field shows real-time feedback as you type a trigger
  • Dynamic Fields Help — In-editor documentation for all 9 dynamic field types

    • Bug Fixes

  • Cursor Positioning Fixed — Uses Accessibility API for reliable cursor placement in all apps
  • Fill-in Fields Focus — Dialog now properly restores focus to the previous app after inserting
  • Multiple {cursor} Handling — Extra `{cursor}` tags are stripped cleanly; only the first is used
    • ---

    What's New in v1.5.5

    Bug Fixes

  • Intel Mac Support Fixed — Now builds as a verified Universal Binary (arm64 + x86_64)
    • ---

    What's New in v1.5.4

    Bug Fixes

  • Intel Mac Support — App now builds as a Universal Binary for both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs
  • AI Generation Fixed — Updated to latest Claude model
    • ---

    What's New in v1.5.3

    Improvements

  • Stability improvements — Minor fixes and performance tuning
    • ---

    What's New in v1.5.2

    Improvements

  • Auto-Updates Fixed — Resolved update issues on macOS 26
    • ---

    What's New in v1.5.1

    Improvements

  • UI Enhancements — Minor polish and performance improvements
    • ---

    What's New in v1.5.0

    New

  • Analytics Consent — Choose whether to share anonymous usage data on first launch
  • Update Notifications — Subtle in-app banner when a new version is available
    • ---

    What's New in v1.4.9

    Bug Fixes

  • Free AI Trial Fixed — Automatically retries with free trial when stale authentication prevents generation
    • ---

    What's New in v1.4.8

    Bug Fixes

  • Free AI Trial Fixed — Properly clears stale authentication from previous installations so free trial works on all machines
    • ---

    What's New in v1.4.7

    Bug Fixes

  • Free AI Trial Fixed — Free AI generation now works on all machines, including those with previous Retext installations
    • ---

    What's New in v1.4.6

    Bug Fixes

  • Free AI Trial Fixed — Free AI generation now works reliably on all machines
    • ---

    What's New in v1.4.5

    New

  • Send Feedback — Share feedback and feature requests directly from Settings
  • Updated Pricing — Pro now starts at $4.99/month
    • ---

    What's New in v1.4.4

    New

  • Try AI Free — Free users get 1 complimentary AI generation to experience the feature
    • ---

    What's New in v1.4.3

    Improvements

  • More Free Snippets — Free tier now includes 5 snippets (up from 3)
  • Snippet Counter — See how many snippets you've used at a glance
    • ---

    What's New in v1.4.1

    Improvements

  • License Status — Toolbar badge now updates immediately when license state changes
  • Expired License Notice — Clear notification when your license has expired, with a Renew button
    • ---

    What's New in v1.4.0

    Teams & Collaboration

  • Team Snippets — Create a team, invite members, and share snippets across your organization
  • Seat-Based Plans — Starter (5 seats), Pro (15 seats), and Business (50 seats) tiers with monthly and yearly billing
  • Real-Time Sync — Team snippets sync automatically with 30-second polling
  • Offline Support — Team snippets cached locally in SQLite so they work without internet
  • Conflict Resolution — Smart handling when two members edit the same snippet
  • Role-Based Permissions — Owner, admin, and member roles with appropriate access controls

    • Authentication

  • Google Sign-In — Sign in with your Google account to access team features
  • Secure Tokens — JWT-based authentication with automatic token refresh

    • UI Improvements

  • Team Selector — Switch between personal and team snippet libraries from the sidebar
  • Sync Status — See sync status in the sidebar header
  • Native Toolbar — Cleaner toolbar with system-style buttons
  • Updated Logo — New branding in link previews and Open Graph images

    • Website

  • Prompt Library — 2,467 curated prompts for programmatic SEO pages
  • Beta Page — Hidden /beta page for early adopter testing
    • ---

    What's New in v1.3.5

    Bug Fixes

  • Window Resize Fixed — Resize cursors now appear correctly when hovering window edges
    • ---

    v1.3.4

    Improvements

  • Improved Edit View — Cleaner layout with tags inline, no scrolling required
  • Better Title Input — Titles now enforce max length as you type
  • Clearer Read-Only View — Content displays without input-style background
    • ---

    v1.3.3

    Improvements

  • Better License Activation — License key entry is now at the top of the upgrade window, no scrolling needed
    • ---

    v1.3.2

    Improvements

  • Clearer Upgrade Messaging — Updated in-app Pro upgrade prompts with benefit-focused copy
    • ---

    v1.3.1

    Bug Fixes

  • Fixed Checkout Links — Updated all purchase/upgrade links to the correct checkout page
    • ---

    v1.3.0

    New Branded App Icon

  • Fresh Look — New green logo with white "R" matches the retext.io website
  • Better Recognition — Stand out in your Dock and app switcher

    • Enhanced About Window

  • Credits — Retext menu → About Retext now shows tagline and website link
  • Copyright — Displays "© 2024-2026 Retext. All rights reserved."

    • Snippet Settings

  • Max Title Length — Set your preferred limit (10-40 characters) in Settings
  • Auto-Remove Spaces — Spaces are automatically stripped from titles (toggle in Settings)
  • Cleaner Titles — Semicolons are automatically removed from titles

    • Improved Validation

  • Instant Feedback — Errors and warnings now appear directly under the title as you type
  • Conflict Prevention — Can't create triggers that would conflict (e.g., "em" and "email")
  • Helpful Suggestions — When blocked, see alternative trigger names you can use
  • Friendlier Messages — Shorter, clearer error messages

    • Better Editing Experience

  • Type Triggers Freely — Snippet expansion is disabled when editing in Retext
  • No Accidental Triggers — Type `;hello` in your content without it expanding
    • ---

    Previous Releases

    v1.2.x — Automatic Updates

  • Automatic update notifications on app launch

    • v1.1.x — Tag-Based Organization

  • New three-panel layout with tags sidebar
  • Add tags to snippets for organization
  • Filter snippets by tag

    • v1.0.x — Initial Release

  • NavigationSplitView layout with sidebar
  • Tinted button styles and hover effects
  • Infinite loop prevention and snippet validation
  • Keyboard shortcuts: ⌘E to edit, ⌘↩ to save, Esc to cancel
